report.summary: Four survivors: unresolved-dependencies (high), cache-key-language-omission (high), egress-on-read (medium), python-imports-gap (medium). First two block correctness and are gate 0; latter two are gate 1.
risks: Missing definitions in containment.py/graph_delta.py may cause runtime NameError if not fixed.
Cache key omission can cause silent data corruption for multi-language projects.
Egress gate on reads may block legitimate PR reading operations.
Python imports may be missing from index if merge not done.
todos: Verify and fix missing symbol definitions in containment.py and graph_delta.py.
Fix cache key in cache.py to include language parameter.
Clarify egress gate behavior for reads in transport.py.
Ensure index.py merges python_imports for Python files.

items.title: Add missing symbol definitions in containment.py and graph_delta.py
items.why_now: Without these definitions, runtime NameError occurs on any code path that calls them, blocking all downstream functionality.

steps.do: Add missing import _adv32api or define it in daedalus/spine/containment.py

items.assumption: The missing symbols are indeed defined elsewhere; if full files reveal they are already defined, this step is unnecessary.

items.title: Fix cache key in cache.py to include language parameter
items.why_now: Cache key omission can cause collisions for files with same path and content but different languages, leading to incorrect cached results.

steps.do: Modify file_key function signature to include language parameter and incorporate it into the key

items.assumption: No caller currently passes language via spec_name; if they do, the fix may be redundant.

items.title: Clarify egress gate behavior for reads in transport.py
items.why_now: Ambiguity may cause incorrect blocking of read operations, breaking PR reading functionality.

steps.do: Inspect screen_egress implementation in daedalus/adapters/transport.py (or related sensitivity module) to determine if it distinguishes read vs write
steps.verified_by: Manual inspection; update docstring if needed

steps.do: If screen_egress blocks reads incorrectly, modify it to allow reads or add a read-specific parameter

items.assumption: The settling check will reveal the implementation; if screen_egress already handles reads correctly, no change needed.

items.title: Ensure index.py merges python_imports for Python files
items.why_now: If index.py relies solely on extract_imports, Python imports are missing, causing incomplete dependency analysis.

steps.do: Open daedalus/eval/__main__.py and trace call to index.py to verify merge
steps.verified_by: Manual inspection; if merge missing, add call to parse.python_imports in index.py

steps.do: If merge missing, modify index.py to call python_imports for Python files and merge results

items.assumption: The settling check will confirm whether merge is already done; if yes, no change needed.
